title: never miss a public works show ✨ @The Public Theater #publicworks #pu...
transcript: I'm headed to church which can only mean one thing something theatrical happening at a church this is the eighth largest cathedral in the world it's public works it's my favorite thing we're here for Pericles it's totally free there are no tickets you just line up we got in line at like sixish now they’re letting everybody in but it holds a lot of people so I don't actually think you have to get here like super super early but it's only running until Tuesday this place is very pretty the cast is wild I love public works it's really cool cause they bring groups from like all over the city all together and it's just so beautiful and I always cry and this church is sorry cathedral is amazing it's time Pericles is one of Shakespeare's great adventure tales it’s a story of love and loss and faith and finding your way home your way home and the public has completely reimagined it as a gospel musical filling this giant cathedral with joy and music and community the space is massive but they do have a lot of screens throughout the cathedral so even if you're far back you'll be able to see and the acoustics are incredible there's also some sensational performances by Ato Blankson-Wood Crystal Lucas-Perry Denée Benton and Alex Newell as a literal goddess I really cannot express how large this cathedral is and how amazing it feels to be in community with this many people they gave us the play and like a public edition so cool that was wonderful I wept I don't know there's just something so special about seeing what 150 New Yorkers ages 11 to 84 all on stage all together and yeah you have the Alex Newells Crystal Lucas-Perry’s and the Denée Bentons like Tony nominations or Tony wins but almost everybody else are just like everyday New Yorkers who love theatre my city so much and I just think it is so special you have until September 2nd totally free see it
